data.title: 砂狼白子 · 晨光微澜床榻上的无声信赖
data.description: 纯白棉质窗帘透进清透宁静的清晨微光。松软的白色被褥间，白子身穿浅蓝色纯棉吊带背心，银灰短发略显凌乱。她毫无防备地侧卧在老师身侧，健美紧致的小腹与修长双腿在晨光下泛着瓷白光泽，冰蓝色的眼眸一眨不眨地凝望着刚醒来的老师，流露出极致的温顺与无声交付。
data.location: bright airy morning bedroom bed with white linen
data.action: lying on white sheets, morning sunlight, soft blue camisole, defenseless gentle gaze, subtle blush
data.lighting: ethereal pure morning sunshine diffusing through white sheer curtains
data.mood: pure peaceful devotion, serene morning vulnerability, and sensual innocence
data.promptProse: Lying peacefully in a sun-drenched morning bed in a light blue cotton camisole, Sunaookami Shiroko looks up with soft blue eyes, her wolf ears relaxed against white pillows.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko resting defenselessly on the sunlit bed in a soft camisole with sweet devotion.
